programme.title: The Super Secret Service
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Directed by Charles W. Green. Stars Peter Sellers, Graham Stark, Dick Emery & Raymond Francis. Brilliantly bizarre comedy short about the workings of the 'Super Secret Service'. [S]

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: The Doctor. 1958. Stars Boris Karloff, Katherine Squire & Peter Miller. A young surgeon is denied permission to operate on a dying girl, eerie questions arise about trust and second chances. [S]

programme.title: The Starlost
programme.desc: The Invasion - Part 1. 1973. Stars Kier Dullea, Gay Rowan & Robin Ward. With Devon seriously injured, Rachel's call for help reaches the Astro-medic ship.

programme.title: Green Hornet Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Tragic Crash. 1941. Starring: Warren Hull. When Brett Reid and 'The Sentinel' take an interest in a building racket, the crime syndicate decide to take revenge on the paper. [S]

programme.title: The Adventures of Sir Lancelot
programme.desc: Double Identity. 1957. Stars William Russell, Cyril Smith & Ronald Leigh-Hunt. Sir Richard is waylaid just as he is set to marry Lady Margret. Sir Lancelot suspect foul play. [S]

programme.title: Honey West
programme.desc: 1965. Invitation To Limbo. Crime series produced by Aaron Spelling & stars Anne Francis. An electronics firm hires Honey to find an industrial spy who has been leaking company secrets.

programme.title: Gold Is Where You Find It
programme.desc: Director: Francis Searle. Stars Eddie Byrne, Dermot Kelly. Steve returns to Ireland after 20 years a millionaire. When he gets drunk and loses his gold nuggets, everyone thinks there's a gold rush.

programme.title: Stranger From Venus
programme.desc: 1954. Sci-fi. Directed by Burt Balaban. A beautifully-crafted tale. A woman (Patricia Neal) meets a man (Dantine) from Venus with no pulse to warn Earth about the atom. Also starring Derek Bond. [S]

programme.title: Doctor In The House
programme.desc: 1954. Comedy. Directed by Ralph Thomas. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Muriel Pavlow & Kenneth More. The adventures of a new medical student and his friends at St. Swithin's hospital in London. [S]

programme.title: The Love Match
programme.desc: Comedy. Director: David Paltenghi. Stars Arthur Askey, Glenn Melvyn & Thora Hird. Two football loving railway workers get into trouble after racing their engine home to get to a match on time. [S]

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: The Continental Touch. 1964. Stars Buddy Ebson, Irene Ryan, Donna Douglas. Elly learns how to be a lady at the old dress boutique and Drysdale mistakes her for royalty. [S]

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: The Unkindest Tut of All. 1967. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Yvonne Craig. Tut fakes crime predictions to gain police trust, then lures them away to steal scrolls tied to a statue of cosmic power. [S]

programme.title: Peter Murray Takes you to...
programme.desc: ... Nottingham. 1983. Travel to Nottingham with Pete Murray, a city which in medieval times was enclosed by walls. See the beautiful River Trent, the towering Trent Polytechnic and so much more. [S]

programme.title: Genevieve
programme.desc: 1953. Comedy. Director Henry Cornelius. Stars Kenneth More, Dinah Sheridan and Kay Kendall. Alan and Ambrose are not going to let friendship get in the way of winning the London to Brighton rally. [S]

programme.title: Colonel March Investigates
programme.desc: 1953. Crime drama starring Boris Karloff, Joan Sims and Richard Wattis. Colonel March runs the Scotland Yard office for the Department of Queer Complaints and investigates 3 strange crimes. [S]

programme.title: The Man from U.N.C.L.E
programme.desc: The Brain-Killer Affair. 1965. Stars Robert Vaughn, David McCallum & Leo G. Carroll. Thrush poisons Waverly, with plans to subject him to a procedure that affects the brain. [S]

programme.title: The Footage Detectives
programme.desc: The legend Melvyn Hayes joins Mike & Noel this week! There's rare reels of Melvyn's early career & a look at a Water Rats meeting packed with British stars of stage and screen. [S]

programme.title: The Directors
programme.desc: Sir David Lean, the British two time Academy Award winning director is best known for his extraordinary cinematic epics like The Bridge on the River Kwai (1957) and Lawrence of Arabia (1962). [S]

programme.title: That's My Boy
programme.desc: The Big Night Out. 1984. Stars Mollie Sugden, Christopher Blake & Jennifer Lonsdale. Ida is infuriated when consultant Charles Barber invites Mrs Price to a dinner. [S]

programme.title: The Vise
programme.desc: Death Walks by Night. 1955. Stars Ron Randell, Nanette Newman & Michael Ashwin. A scream leads to the body of a murdered girl and one of the witnesses is murdered while telephoning the police. [S]

programme.title: Sergeant Cork
programme.desc: The Case of the Hooded Students. 1966. Stars John Barrie, William Gaunt, Charles Morgan & Windsor Davis. Head teacher of a private boys school is bound, tied and put on trial by a hooded court. [S]

programme.title: Confessions of a Window Cleaner
programme.desc: 1974. Comedy. Directed by Val Guest. Stars Anthony Booth, Robin Askwith & Dandy Nichols. The adventures of an optimistic and inept window cleaner who finds other ways to satisfy his customers.

programme.title: The Heritage Chart Show with Mike Read
programme.desc: A TOTP style TV Show for Heritage Artists based on the Heritage Chart which is voted on in over 80 countries. Songs you love from popular artists, live and on video with the odd interview.

programme.title: The Claim
programme.desc: 2000. Romance. Director: Michael Winterbottom. Stars Peter Mullan, Milla Jovovich & Wes Bentley. A man who sold his wife and daughter to get ahead in business has his past come back to haunt him. [S]
